summary: Blocker 1 fixed without a build parameter (V05 holds): imageBuildRequired() now returns true when the build's changeset holds no file at all (`!utils.hasChanges('.*')`) — that is the version poller's weekly rebuild, which triggers the job with no commits and, because the positional helmCharts.kaniko cannot stamp the params label DockerImages replays, no parameters either; confirmed against Jenkins that such a build carries an empty changeset and an indistinguishable user cause, so the changeset is the only available signal. Minor 1 resolved by watching `Jenkinsfile\.iac-image` as a sixth pattern, so a change to the Dockerfile path, context or tags builds itself — the push landing this phase is therefore also the first pipeline proof of the build path. Gate `kc project test --project root` (no test statements) and `kc project lint` both green; done-record updated, Jenkinsfile committed on phase/013-PA, plan.md committed in AnsibleSpecs.
